name: resizable
title: Resizable Panels
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: Split-pane layouts with smooth drag-to-resize, min/max constraints, and collapsible panels. Zero re-renders during drag — CSS custom properties handle all position updates.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/resizable. Wrap panels with ResizableRoot, add a ResizablePanel for each pane, and a ResizableHandle between them. Configure direction, min/max sizes, and collapse behavior via config. Use useResizable for programmatic control inside any child component.
